messages.content: The freight carrier just moved the Denver crate delivery to Monday at 4:30 p.m. I need to be at the gallery by then, and the Delta flight we booked arrives too late. Please see what earlier outbound I can change to. The Thursday evening return and the Catbird stay should remain as they are.

I’ll check earlier Delta options for Monday, August 18, keeping the Thursday, August 21 return at 6:40 p.m. unchanged. What time do you need to reach the gallery to allow for the drive from the airport?
By 3:30 would be sensible. I’ll have one checked bag, and I don’t want to risk a tight arrival.

There are two nonstop Delta departures that would work. The 7:10 a.m. flight arrives Denver at 8:25 a.m.; changing to it would add $83 to the ticket. The 9:35 a.m. flight arrives at 10:52 a.m. and would add $46. Both retain the 6:40 p.m. Thursday nonstop return. Fare differences are current and can change until the exchange is completed.
Take the 7:10. The extra margin matters with a freight appointment. Does changing only that segment affect the checked-bag estimate?

No. The expected checked-bag charge remains $35 each way, or $70 total, unless a waiver applies. The revised airfare would be $529 after the $83 additional collection. Would you like me to exchange the ticket now?
Before you do, check the hotel. I’ll reach Catbird far earlier than normal check-in. Can they either give me the room early or hold my luggage while I go to the gallery?

Catbird’s standard check-in is at 4:00 p.m. They cannot guarantee an early room this far in advance, but they will hold luggage at the front desk on arrival at no charge. Your reservation can remain August 18-21 with no rate change. They can also add an early-arrival request to the booking, subject to availability that morning.
Good. Add the request and note that I may only drop the bag if the room is not ready. No need to change the dates or room.
The hotel has added the early-arrival request and a note that you may leave one bag with the front desk. The standard studio, dates, $674.22 total, and cancellation deadline are unchanged.
Now exchange the outbound for the 7:10 a.m. flight. Keep the Thursday return exactly as booked, and don’t add insurance or anything else.

To confirm before ticketing: Delta will collect an additional $83, bringing the airfare to $529. The itinerary will depart Atlanta Monday, August 18 at 7:10 a.m., arrive Denver at 8:25 a.m., and return Thursday, August 21 at 6:40 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 11:32 p.m. No insurance or optional services will be added.

The exchange is complete under the existing Delta confirmation H7Q4LM. Your new outbound is the nonstop departing Atlanta at 7:10 a.m. Monday, August 18 and arriving Denver at 8:25 a.m. The Thursday 6:40 p.m. return is unchanged. Delta collected the $83 fare difference, making the revised airfare $529. The expected checked-bag total remains $70 unless waived. Catbird confirmation CB-481730 remains one standard studio for August 18-21 at $674.22; the hotel added the early-arrival request and will hold one bag at no charge if the room is not ready. With airfare, lodging, and estimated bag fees, the revised trip total is $1,273.22, which is $23.22 above the prior $1,250 approval.
